runs.name: Evolution Metals & Technologies Corp.
runs.box: OUT AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$1.47** (close 2026-10-12, aggregator quote through `tools/sources.py`, flagged). Shares **627,200,646**, one class (424B3 filed 2026-10-09, acc 0001213900-26-108471, "As of October 2, 2026"; 621,800,646 on the 10-Q cover by `Screens/cover_shares.py`, 621,790,646 issued and outstanding at 2026-06-30, no treasury; the difference Yorkville conversions); cap **$922M**. Sovereign **5.6%** (USD; Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-09). The registrant is the former Welsbach Technology Metals Acquisition Corp. (a SPAC), merged with Evolution Metals LLC on 2026-01-05 with four Korean companies (Handa Lab, KCM Industry, KMMI, NS World) acquired; its XBRL is the SPAC's history, `tools/run.py` produced no lines, every figure read from the filed statements. Filings read: the FY2025 10-K (0001213900-26-018858, the SPAC's statements only), the 8-K/A of 2026-03-31 (0001213900-26-036749, the predecessor's and two targets' audited statements, the four targets' MD&A), the 10-Qs of 2026-05-22 (fetched) and 2026-08-17 (0001213900-26-090427), the 8-Ks of 2026-05-26 (item 3.01) and 2026-09-18 (Yorkville debentures), the 424B3 of 2026-10-09; no proxy of the combined company exists, the SPAC's listed, not read; the 7.01 8-Ks not read. One figure cross-checked: six-month revenue $3,515 thousand on the face of the statement of operations, equal to the revenue table and the pro forma note. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7, with the 8-K/A and 10-Q in place of the SPAC's Item 7. Competitors: the 10-K names none, so no comparison was built and none chosen. **Q1 OUT**, a start-up, on Q1's own list of what it rules out: the business the $922M price rests on is a planned U.S. campus of about 55,000 tonnes a year of magnet capacity "within two years", some eighty times the Korean plants' 400 and 260 tonnes a year; the business that exists is four small Korean companies with about $8.2M of 2025 revenue between them, every one at an operating loss and under going-concern doubt, KMMI never having had revenue; under EMAT, six months to 2026-06-30, revenue $3.5M, operating loss $27.8M, cash $5.3M against a working-capital deficit of $78.8M, going-concern doubt; the past statements (a trust account, a financing vehicle, small loss-making targets) do not tell the future ones. The analyst recorded TOO HARD (NATURE) as the defensible alternative reading. Q2 to Q12 not reached. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash after stock pay and investor-paid expenses, the combined half-year annualized central (a CONVENTION of the run, fewer than five years of the business existing), $(54.7)M a year (three-period mean $(22.3)M beside); every period negative, so the range is the no-growth case alone, **$(1.58) a share** all-equity ($(1.56) equity-only), net debt $21.9M ($69.9M with the Step 6-D payables beside), against $1.47; no case earns the floor; fair **$(0.90)** all-equity, $(0.87) equity-only, no positive figure; no alert. Balance sheets: ten years do not exist; every one that does was read (SPAC 2024 to 2025, predecessor 2024 to 2025, KCM and NS World 2024 to 2025, combined at 2026-06-30); equity negative at every date, goodwill $58.9M of $95.1M total assets, total deficit $(18.85)M; the 10-Q's 2025-12-31 comparative (total assets $22.49M) does not match the audited predecessor ($26.67M), not reconciled. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: the 10-K says the company "owns and operates" battery-grade sulfates, pCAM and U.S. processing infrastructure where the 10-Q reports magnet materials only and calls the U.S. campus "planned"; two late 10-Qs and a Nasdaq notice (cured 2026-05-26); variable-price Yorkville convertibles at 95% of the lowest five-day VWAP with an amortization trigger and 18% default interest; an equity plan of 225M shares against 627M outstanding; one customer 42% of revenue, export sales all to China; related-party flows. Contamination declared by the analyst: ASTE commit subjects, AYI and ARCB folder names, a memory index line naming no company; nothing used. Commits 830ab25a, 59371b11, 11e99316. Citations: the analyst's check PASS; the dispatcher's script (`dispatcher_cite_check.py`) checked 19 quotations, no slip; 23 ids, all in the ledger, no E-id. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) "start-up" is not defined: Q1 lists start-ups under OUT while L2000-026 on new businesses reads as the TOO HARD ground; a company priced on unbuilt capacity, whatever the age of its shell or its acquired subsidiaries, needs a sentence saying which; the box would differ, the computation and any alert would not; (2) Q7's five-year window has no rule for a de-SPAC or a recent merger with less than five years of the business; (3) the template's eight to ten years of balance sheets cannot be met for such a company; (4) the brief's competitor rule returns nothing where the 10-K names no rival. Could not get: five years of the business, any named rival, the 10-Q comparative reconciliation, the 7.01 8-Ks, KMMI's and Handa Lab's full statements (MD&A only).
runs.narr: Q1 OUT: a de-SPAC (formerly Welsbach Technology Metals Acquisition Corp., merged 2026-01-05) priced at $922M on a planned U.S. rare earth magnet and battery-materials campus some eighty times the capacity that exists; the business that exists is four small Korean magnet and component companies with about $8.2M of 2025 revenue, all at an operating loss, under going-concern doubt; a start-up on Q1's own list. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: range $(1.58) a share all-equity (no-growth case alone, owner cash about $(54.7)M a year) against $1.47, fair $(0.90) all-equity ($(0.87) equity-only), no positive figure, not armed. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: the 10-K's "owns and operates" against the 10-Q's "planned", two late 10-Qs and a Nasdaq notice, variable-price Yorkville convertibles.
